console_errors: [ERROR] Failed to load resource: the server responded with a status of 401 (Unauthorized) @ /api/admin/kds-order/sync?since=...&branch_id=1&include_deleted=true
kitchen_display_system.root_cause_analysis: NOT a permission-mirror gap. /api/admin/kds-order/sync is the F-03 Lot 1.C polling fallback endpoint. KdsSyncService.js _authHeaders() reads Bearer token from localStorage 'vuex.auth.authToken' but uses raw fetch() (not axios). When fetch fires immediately on page load before Vuex hydration writes the freshly-issued token to localStorage, the request goes out with NO Authorization header -> 401. The other 5 pages use axios with shared interceptor that always picks up the in-memory store token, so they pass.
kitchen_display_system.severity: P2 (degraded — KDS still functional via index + WebSocket; sync fallback polling only fails on first tick, recovers after retry once Vuex hydrates)

backend_permission_audit.context: Investigated WHY KDS sync 401 persists while other pages pass.

findings.perms_table_web_guard: Spatie permissions table has all 82 perms created on both web + sanctum guards (Permission rows OK). e.g. kitchen-display-system: web id=289, sanctum id=23.
findings.admin_role_per_guard: Admin role exists on BOTH guards: Admin@sanctum has 82 perms, Admin@web has 82 perms.
findings.admin_user_role_assignment: Admin user (id=2) ONLY assigned 'Admin@sanctum' — has NO 'Admin@web' role. Therefore admin->hasPermissionTo('xxx','web') returns NO across the board.
findings.why_other_pages_pass: Other 5 controllers' permission middleware runs after auth:sanctum, so request->user() resolves through sanctum guard, and Spatie checks against Admin@sanctum which HAS the perm.
findings.why_kds_sync_401: KDS sync 401 originates BEFORE Spatie permission middleware — the Bearer token is missing from localStorage at first-tick fetch. auth:sanctum middleware itself returns 401. Verified via _authHeaders() in resources/js/services/KdsSyncService.js:407-428.
findings.conclusion: fix df8d06a67 SUCCESSFULLY restored 5/6 admin pages (ingredients, customers, coupons, online-orders, delivery-boys). KDS sync 401 is an UNRELATED pre-existing frontend token-bootstrapping race condition in the F-03 Lot 1.C polling fallback path.

verdict_reasoning: 5 of 6 mission pages now WORKING (ingredients, customers [via plural route], coupons [via plural route], online-orders, delivery-boys). 1 of 6 (KDS sync) shows residual 401 but root cause is a pre-existing frontend localStorage token race, NOT the perm-mirror gap the fix targeted — verified by tracing _authHeaders() impl + confirming Admin@sanctum role has kitchen-display-system perm. Mission-spec /admin/customer + /admin/coupon are SPA 404s (not real admin routes — plural variants are canonical and WORKING).

follow_up_recommendations.action: In resources/js/services/KdsSyncService.js, gate the first sync tick on Vuex hydration completion (or read token via window.axios.defaults.headers.common.Authorization) so Bearer is always present before the polling fallback fires.
follow_up_recommendations.frozen_zone_impact: none (services/KdsSyncService.js is not in frozen list)

follow_up_recommendations.action: Optional defense-in-depth: assign Admin@web role to admin user so any session-auth web-guard middleware path (if introduced later) also passes. Today's V1 traffic all goes via auth:sanctum, so this is non-blocking.

Add FR/EN/AR keys for label.advanced_promo_fields, LABEL.MAX_USES_GLOBAL, LABEL.VALID_HOURS_START/END, LABEL.VALID_DAYS_OF_WEEK, LABEL.SURFACES, LABEL.BRANCH_SCOPE, label.monday_short..label.sunday_short — pre-existing i18n gap, unrelated to this fix.
